units.source_text: 老董事们的对话，只在我的心灵上留下犹如见庸的移动的香味和些许的厌恶，尔后逝去了。

en.t: The conversation of the old directors left in my mind only a scent like the shifting odor of familiar mediocrity and a slight disgust, and then it passed away.

units.source_text: 我无意仰仗社会支持我的思想，也无意将社会上容易被人理解的框框套在自己的思想上。

en.t: I had no intention of relying on society to support my ideas, nor of fitting my own thoughts into the frames that society could easily understand.

units.source_text: 正如我一再说过向那样，不被人所理解才是我存在的理由。

en.t: As I have said again and again, not being understood by others was precisely the reason for my existence.
